uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Java 25 runtime
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Java 25 runtime is now generally available in App Engine flexible environment; The Java 25 runtime is now available in Preview in App Engine flexible environment.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment TLS 1.2+ support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment now supports TLS version 1.2 and later with a corresponding secure set of cipher suites.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment TLS legacy version support deprecation
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Support for TLS version 1.1 and earlier is deprecated in App Engine flexible environment in favor of TLS 1.2 and later; deprecated on March 2025.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine runtime lifecycle stage filtering in Cloud Console
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Cloud Console for App Engine now supports filtering flexible environment versions by runtime lifecycle stages and shows warning icons for lifecycle states.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Java 21 runtime
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Java 21 runtime is now generally available in App Engine flexible environment; The Java 21 runtime is now available in Preview in App Engine flexible environment.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine Java runtime Maven wrapper support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine Java runtime now supports using Maven wrappers to manage project Maven dependencies.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Java 11 runtime
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Java 11 runtime is now generally available in App Engine flexible environment and requires specifying an operating system version in app.yaml.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Java 17 runtime
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Java 17 runtime is now generally available in App Engine flexible environment and requires specifying an operating system version in app.yaml.

uncovered_features.feature_name: SSH access to internal-only App Engine flexible instances
uncovered_features.feature_summary: SSH access is now supported for App Engine flexible environment instances that use only internal IP addresses.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Java 11 preview runtime
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Java 11 runtime is now available in Preview on secure modern operating systems, with Google Cloud buildpacks and updated app.yaml requirements.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Java 17 preview runtime
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Java 17 runtime is now available in Preview on secure modern operating systems, with Google Cloud buildpacks and updated app.yaml requirements.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Disable external ephemeral IP addresses for App Engine Flex services
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine Flexible services can be configured to disable external ephemeral IP addresses.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability expansion
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in new regions: us-west1 (Oregon), asia-southeast1 (Singapore), and asia-east1 (Taiwan); App Engine became available in the europe-central2 (Warsaw) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine network ingress control for VPC and Cloud Load Balancing
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine added ingress controls that can restrict incoming traffic to requests from a project's VPC or Cloud Load Balancing.
keywords: allow only VPC or load balancer

uncovered_features.feature_name: Fine-grained billing for App Engine services
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine added support for labeling services and exporting billing data to BigQuery for detailed per-resource billing analysis.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in us-west3
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the us-west3 (Salt Lake City) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine region-ID app hostnames
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine app request URLs now can include a region ID to route traffic more efficiently and reliably.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in asia-northeast2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the asia-northeast2 (Osaka) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in europe-west6
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the europe-west6 (Zurich) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Cloud Tasks general availability
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Cloud Tasks became generally available for running asynchronous background tasks.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine WebSockets and session affinity support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine added support for using WebSockets and session affinity to maintain persistent connections.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in asia-east2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the asia-east2 (Hong Kong) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in us-west2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the us-west2 (Los Angeles) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in northamerica-northeast1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the northamerica-northeast1 (Montreal) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in asia-south1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the asia-south1 (Mumbai) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Per-second instance billing for App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Instance billing for App Engine flexible environment changed to per-second increments with a one-minute minimum usage threshold.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Legacy App Engine health checks
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Legacy health checks were deprecated and set to be unavailable after the stated removal date; deprecated on 2018-09-30.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Updated split health checks for App Engine projects
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Updated (split) health checks became the default for new App Engine projects, with migration via gcloud app update --split-health-checks.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine custom domain mapping APIs and commands
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine custom domain mapping commands and Admin API methods became generally available, including domain verification and authorizedDomains listing.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Managed SSL certificates for App Engine custom domains
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Existing custom domain SSL deployments continue to work, and custom domains can be upgraded to managed SSL certificates; Managed certificates can be used to add SSL to custom domains, with automatic provisioning, renewal, and revocation lifecycle handling.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine Java compat runtime appengine-web.xml configuration updates
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine standard API-compatible Java SDK 1.9.56 added appengine-web.xml options for subnetwork_name, session_affinity, and updated liveness/readiness health checks.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in southamerica-east1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the southamerica-east1 (São Paulo, Brazil) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional availability in europe-west3
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the europe-west3 (Frankfurt, Germany) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine region availability: australia-southeast1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the australia-southeast1 (Sydney) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine region availability: europe-west2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the europe-west2 (London) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine region availability: us-east4
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the us-east4 (North Virginia) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment general availability
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment reached general availability with support for Node.js, Ruby, Python, Java, and Go, and a 99.95% SLA.
keywords: App Engine flexible environment general availability

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine multi-zonal deployment support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment added multi-zonal deployment capability.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Custom machine types for App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment gained support for custom machine types.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Go App Engine package deprecation for flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The older Go App Engine package was deprecated for use on App Engine flexible environment in favor of cloud.google.com/go/ packages; deprecated on 2016-11-15.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Ruby runtime for App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Ruby runtime became available for App Engine flexible environment deployments.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine Managed VM container build method configuration
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Remote container image construction for App Engine Managed VM deployments was introduced with selectable options: default transient Compute Engine VM builds or beta Cloud Build, controlled by the app/use_cloud_build gcloud setting.
